answer: Make first rewards vest only after each identity posts a unique slashable bond kept at risk through real work. A new key must lock collateral sibling keys cannot reuse, then countersign a diverse stretch of peer transactions over several epochs. Buying one sable custody token does not cover a crowd of sockpuppets; every extra identity needs its own deposit. Hold that stake in a sealed walnut box of escrow, and release payouts only after a long ocean delay with no clustering flags. A farm then pays capital and waiting time per identity, which prices out cheap spam.
